historySource.indexText: Authorized as a national monument March 4, 1929; established Jan. 24, 1939; redesignated a national park Nov. 10, 1978. Boundary changes: June 26, 1936; May 7, 1952; March 22, 1957; Aug. 8, 1968. Wilderness designated Oct. 20, 1976.
